entities.name: Ramaz
entities.description: Shamanic human planeswalker and crazed visionary who manipulated Chandra into stealing the Dragon Scroll; minion of a greater dragon.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who hunted Ramaz for vengeance.

entities.name: Dragon Scroll
entities.description: Item Chandra was manipulated into stealing.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings whose rise followed the theft of the Dragon Scroll.

events.summary: Ramaz manipulated Chandra into stealing the Dragon Scroll, leading to the rise of the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
events.quote: responsible for manipulating Chandra Nalaar into stealing the Dragon Scroll

events.summary: Chandra tracked Ramaz across planes seeking vengeance.
events.quote: she tracked his progress across multiple planes

events.summary: Chandra confronted Ramaz on Kaldheim; he escaped after a skirmish, revealing he served a greater dragon.
events.quote: After a skirmish he escaped, revealing that he had only been a minion in a yet greater scheme

relations.quote: She was intent on seeking her vengeance
